key_facts: This document shows the final grid positions for the 2026 Barcelona-Catalunya Grand Prix qualifying session on 13 June 2026.
George Russell driving for Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team took pole position with a best lap time of 1:14.679 in Q3, the fastest lap overall.
Lewis Hamilton in the Ferrari finished second on the grid with a best Q3 time of 1:14.743.
Kimi Antonelli in the Mercedes finished third with a Q3 time of 1:14.998.
Charles Leclerc did not finish Q3 (marked DNF) and qualified tenth, despite having the third-fastest time in Q2.
plain_explanation:
The document records the final qualifying classification for the 2026 Barcelona-Catalunya Grand Prix. George Russell in the Mercedes took pole position, the first place on the grid. His fastest lap was 1:14.679, which he set in Q3, the third and final qualifying session. This was the quickest lap of the entire qualifying session.

Russell's fastest time in Q1, the first qualifying session, was 1:15.717. His time improved to 1:15.228 in Q2, the second session, and then to 1:14.679 in Q3.

Lewis Hamilton finished second on the grid in a Ferrari. His best time overall was 1:14.743 in Q3. Kimi Antonelli finished third in the other Mercedes with a Q3 best of 1:14.998.

Charles Leclerc did not finish Q3 (marked DNF on the sheet). He had the third-fastest time in Q2 at 1:15.281 and completed only two laps in Q3 before stopping, so he was classified tenth based on his Q2 time.
